tools.name: read_cart
tools.description: List the cart's lines — name, size (when the product has one), quantity, and line total. Returns `items`: a list of objects with keys {line_total, name, option, quantity}. One row per cart line; empty when the cart is empty.

returns.description: One row per cart line; empty when the cart is empty.

tools.name: increase_quantity
tools.description: Add one more unit to a cart line, by product name, and return the lines. Returns `items`: a list of objects with keys {line_total, name, quantity}.

tools.name: decrease_quantity
tools.description: Remove one unit from a cart line, by product name, and return the lines. Does nothing at quantity 1 (the button is disabled); use remove_from_cart instead. Returns `items`: a list of objects with keys {line_total, name, quantity}.

tools.name: remove_from_cart
tools.description: Remove a line from the cart by product name and return the lines left. Returns `items`: a list of objects with keys {name, quantity}.

tools.name: apply_coupon
tools.description: Enter a coupon code and apply it. The server decides; the returned message says whether it was accepted (SAVE10 and WELCOME5 are) or rejected. Returns `value` (string): The status line, e.g. "SAVE10 applied: 10% off".

returns.description: The status line, e.g. "SAVE10 applied: 10% off".

tools.name: read_totals
tools.description: Read the cart's subtotal, discount, and total (before shipping). Returns `items`: a list of objects with keys {discount, subtotal, total}.

tools.name: proceed_to_checkout
tools.description: Go from the cart to checkout. Only shown when the cart has lines.

tools.name: continue_shopping
tools.description: Return from the cart to the catalog.

tools.name: list_products
tools.description: List the products currently shown in the catalog, with price, category, stock, and whether each is already in the cart. Returns `items`: a list of objects with keys {category, in_cart, name, price, stock}. One row per visible product card.

returns.description: One row per visible product card.

tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Type into the catalog search box (matches product name and description) and return the products still shown. Pass an empty string to clear the search. Returns `items`: a list of objects with keys {category, name, price, stock}.

tools.name: filter_by_category
tools.description: Show only one category of product (or All), and return the products now shown. Combines with the current search. Returns `items`: a list of objects with keys {category, name, price}.

tools.name: sort_products
tools.description: Sort the catalog and return the products in their new order. Returns `items`: a list of objects with keys {name, price}.

tools.name: open_product
tools.description: Open a product's page from the catalog by its exact name. Navigates to /products/:slug.

name.description: The product name as shown, e.g. "Ethiopia Yirgacheffe".

guidance.reason: pick a size if the product has sizes

tools.name: quick_add_to_cart
tools.description: Add one unit of a product to the cart straight from the catalog (its first size, if it has sizes). Idempotent — a product already in the cart is left alone. Fails on a sold-out product, whose button is disabled. Returns `value` (string): The number of units now in the cart, from the nav badge.

returns.description: The number of units now in the cart, from the nav badge.

tools.name: view_cart
tools.description: Go to the cart from the catalog via the nav link. Navigates to /cart.

tools.name: fill_shipping_details
tools.description: Fill in the five shipping fields. Nothing is validated until place_order.

tools.name: choose_shipping
tools.description: Pick Standard ($5.00, 3–5 days) or Express ($15.00, next day) and return the order total with it. Returns `value` (string): The grand total including shipping.

tools.name: read_order_summary
tools.description: List what is about to be ordered — one row per line with name, quantity, and line total. Returns `items`: a list of objects with keys {name, quantity, total}.

tools.name: read_checkout_totals
tools.description: Read subtotal, discount, shipping, and the grand total. Returns `items`: a list of objects with keys {discount, shipping, subtotal, total}.

tools.name: place_order
tools.description: Submit the order. With valid details this navigates to the confirmation page (/orders/:id) and empties the cart. With invalid details the page stays put and this tool fails — call read_form_errors to see why.

guidance.reason: record the order number and total

tools.name: read_form_errors
tools.description: List the validation errors shown after a failed place_order — which field, and the message. Returns `items`: a list of objects with keys {field, message}. Empty when nothing is wrong or nothing was submitted yet.

returns.description: Empty when nothing is wrong or nothing was submitted yet.

tools.name: back_to_cart
tools.description: Return from checkout to the cart.

tools.name: read_order
tools.description: Read the confirmed order — number, status, shipping line, and total. Returns `items`: a list of objects with keys {number, shipping, status, total}. A single row with the order's details.

returns.description: A single row with the order's details.

tools.name: list_order_items
tools.description: List the items on the confirmed order. Returns `items`: a list of objects with keys {name, quantity, total}.

tools.name: view_order_history
tools.description: Go from the confirmation to the order history. Navigates to /orders.

guidance.reason: see every order placed in this session

tools.name: continue_shopping_from_order
tools.description: Return from the confirmation to the catalog.

tools.name: list_orders
tools.description: List the orders placed in this session — number, item count, total. Returns `items`: a list of objects with keys {items, number, total}. Empty until an order has been placed in this tab.

returns.description: Empty until an order has been placed in this tab.

tools.name: open_order
tools.description: Open one order from the history by its number, e.g. "ORD-1001". Navigates to /orders/:id.

guidance.reason: read its number, shipping, and total

tools.name: read_product
tools.description: Read the open product's title, category, price (for the selected size), and stock. Returns `items`: a list of objects with keys {category, price, stock, title}. A single row with the product's details.

returns.description: A single row with the product's details.

tools.name: choose_option
tools.description: Pick a size (or other option) on the product page and return the price for it. Only products with an OptionGroup have options. Returns `value` (string): The unit price for the chosen option.

option.description: The option label as shown, e.g. "1 kg".

returns.description: The unit price for the chosen option.

tools.name: set_quantity
tools.description: Set how many units the next add_to_cart adds. Returns `value`: a single string.

guidance.reason: add it in that size and quantity

tools.name: add_to_cart
tools.description: Add the open product, in the selected size and quantity, to the cart. Not idempotent — each call adds again. Fails on a sold-out product. Returns `value` (string): The number of units now in the cart.

returns.description: The number of units now in the cart.

tools.name: back_to_shop
tools.description: Return from the product page to the catalog.

tools.name: view_cart_from_product
tools.description: Go to the cart from the product page. Navigates to /cart.

guidance.reason: confirm the line, its size, and its quantity
